required_attestation_limits.base: The receipt declares a deterministic ingest/derivation of exact captured source bytes under the named parser. It does not establish that the source content is authentic, that the source is the one a declaration intended, that the source supports any claim, or that any article or publication is true. It evaluates neither evidence completeness nor claim support, and confers no admission or standing.

notes: PROVISIONAL: This profile is not stable and has not been ratified. It remains provisional until at least two distinct corpus pipelines demonstrate reuse without modification. The identifier srs.editorial.source_ingest.v0.1 is reserved during the provisional period.

SCOPE: covers one stage only, source_ingest. It does not cover capture (srs.editorial.source_capture.v0.2), publication ingest, citation-pack assembly, or verification. A source_ingest receipt references a capture observation via capture_observation_ref and never re-attests capture.
IDENTITY: subject_ref must equal source_artifact_id, the sha256 of the exact captured source bytes. A staging filename must not be promoted to source identity.

pdo_module_identity is a circulated historical identity carried verbatim from the PDO bytes ({module_id, module_version}). It must not be repaired, renamed, or reconciled to the executing distribution.

ingest_implementation is OPTIONAL and substantiated-or-omitted: when present it identifies the executing distribution ({distribution, version, revision}) and must be independently substantiated by run evidence to profile grade; if it cannot be substantiated it must be omitted rather than manufactured. It is never derived from pdo_module_identity. The structural validator does not enforce substantiation; it is not in required_fields.
requires_signing is false for v0.1 structural purposes. Production signing posture is deferred to the emitter implementation.

ENFORCED: derivation.input_hash must equal source_artifact_id, and extraction_ref must equal derivation.output_hash. derivation.parser_id must equal parser_identity. Both directions are validated structurally.
NON-ENFORCED: that source_artifact_id equals the referenced capture's captured_bytes_ref cannot be verified from these receipt bytes alone; the capture receipt is a separate observation.
NON-ENFORCED: append-only retention (source_ingest receipts must not be overwritten) is an emitter/runtime constraint that cannot be verified from receipt bytes alone.
The verifier recomputes receipt structure and the declared digests' internal consistency; it does not re-run the parser and does not establish source truth.
